{{Top|leg}}
'''Stun gas''' was a chemical weapon used to temporarily incapacitate an individual, or a group of individuals. Stun gas could cause confusion, disorientation, or temporary unconsciousness. [[Ulban Arms/Legends|Ulban Arms']] [[S-EP1 security droid]] had a Stun-gas Release Port located on the front of its chest.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
